_: PRE-REGISTERED granularity test (Matt, 2026-08-19): does a finer LOCAL subtype split of accuracy_calibration and tone_manner separate the helpfulness FP/TP populations? Written BEFORE classification.

accuracy_calibration.task_content: correctness/uncertainty of the substantive answer content
accuracy_calibration.self_conduct: honesty/transparency about the assistant's OWN state, instructions, actions, or omissions

tone_manner.delivery_of_help: directness, hedging, watering-down, condescension - how the substance reaches the user
tone_manner.audience_register: politeness, formality, style/register toward an audience

prediction: FPs concentrate in self_conduct + audience_register; TPs in task_content + delivery_of_help. Separation is 'useful' if a wall on the TP-side subtypes recovers >=60% of the 25 FPs at a cost of <=10% of the 75 TPs.
classifier_blindness: the classifier sees node spans + subtype definitions ONLY - no FP/TP status, no behavior definitions, no truth.
